title: The Effectiveness of Canva-Based Interactive Learning Media on the Critical Thinking Skills of Elementary School Students
text_snippet: The Effectiveness of Canva-Based Interactive Learning Media on the Critical Thinking Skills of Elementary School Students This study aimed to develop and test the effectiveness of Canva-based interactive learning media in enhancing critical thinking skills of third-grade students. Employing a Research and Development (R&D) method with the ADDIE model, the research was conducted at SDN Karangsono 01 Jember, involving 22 third-grade students as test subjects. The needs analysis revealed that conventional teaching methods and limited media resulted in suboptimal critical thinking skills among students. The media was developed through design and development phases, receiving a "Very Feasible" validation from material experts (average 4.54) and "Good" from media experts (average 3.62), as well as "Very Good" from teacher responses (average 4.53). title: Teachers’ Perceptions of Deep Learning in History Education
text_snippet: Teachers’ Perceptions of Deep Learning in History Education This study is motivated by the tendency for history instruction in schools to be dominated by conventional, rote-memorization-based methods, which can limit students’ active engagement, motivation, and critical thinking skills. The study aims to describe teachers’ perceptions of the deep learning approach in history instruction and to identify the obstacles they face in implementing this approach at SMA Negeri 2 Sipora. A descriptive qualitative approach was employed. The research informants consisted of three history teachers. Data were collected through checklist-based observation, interviews, and document analysis, and were analyzed through the stages of data collection, reduction, presentation, and conclusion drawing. The results indicate that teachers hold a highly positive perception of deep learning as a student-centered approach that emphasizes in-depth conceptual understanding, specifically learning that is mindful, meaningful, and joyful. This approach has proven effective in enhancing students’ active engagement, motivation, and critical thinking skills by connecting past historical events with real-life contexts. title: Penerapan Problem Based Learning Berbasis Jigsaw untuk Meningkatkan Hasil Belajar Siswa pada Materi Siklus Akuntansi Perusahaan Jasa
text_snippet: Penerapan Problem Based Learning Berbasis Jigsaw untuk Meningkatkan Hasil Belajar Siswa pada Materi Siklus Akuntansi Perusahaan Jasa Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh penerapan model problem based learning (PBL) berbasis jigsaw learning terhadap hasil belajar siswa pada materi siklus akuntansi perusahaan jasa khususnya pada materi jurnal penyesuaian, jurnal penutup dan jurnal pembalik. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode eksperiment dengan desain pre-eksperiment, khususnya one group pretest-posttest design. Penentuan sampel dilakukan dengan teknik sampling jenuh, yaitu menggunakan seluruh siswa dalam satu kelas sebagai sampel penelitian. Teknik pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui pemberian pre-test dan post-test. Selanjutnya, data yang diperoleh dianalisis menggunakan bantuan perangkat lunak SPSS versi 25 melalui analisis statistik deskriptif berupa perhitungan mean, median, dan standar deviasi, serta analisis N-gain untuk mengetahui peningkatan hasil belajar peserta didik setelah penerapan perlakuan. Hasil dari penelitian ini adalah terdapat pengaruh yang signifikan pada penerapan model problem based learning berbasis jigsaw learning terhadap hasil belajar siswa pada materi siklus akuntansi perusahaan jasa, khususnya pada materi jurnal penyesuaian, jurnal penutup dan jurnal pembalik. title: Teacher Strategies Promote Student Integrity in Artificial Intelligence-Supported Learning
text_snippet: Teacher Strategies Promote Student Integrity in Artificial Intelligence-Supported Learning The study investigates teacher strategies for promoting student integrity in artificial intelligence (AI)-supported learning in an Indonesian primary school. It addresses three questions: what strategies teachers use to cultivate character during AI use, what challenges they encounter, and how AI contributes to students’ character development. A qualitative case study was conducted at SDIT Al-Furqan Wahdah Islamiyah Bajeng, involving nine purposively selected informants comprising four classroom teachers, one principal, and four students. Data were collected through in-depth interviews, participant observation, and documentation, then reduced, categorized, and analyzed inductively using an interactive qualitative analysis model. The findings show that teachers promote integrity through process-oriented assessment, integrity checklists, oral verification requiring students to explain AI-generated answers in their own words, time restrictions, and cross-checking AI outputs with textbooks. title: The Influence of Perceived Learning Management System Quality on Student Engagement in the Educational Technology Study Program
text_snippet: The Influence of Perceived Learning Management System Quality on Student Engagement in the Educational Technology Study Program This study aims to determine the effect of the perceived quality of the Learning Management System (LMS) on student engagement in the Educational Technology Study Program. The study used a quantitative approach with a cross-sectional survey design, involving 45 students as participants, selected through purposive sampling based on having participated in learning through the Moodle-based LMS for one semester (16 meetings). Data were collected using the LMS Quality Scale (25 items, covering five dimensions, namely system quality, information quality, instructional quality, interaction quality, and learning quality) and the Online Student Engagement/OSE Scale (19 items) to measure student learning engagement. Both instruments were first pilot-tested with 42 respondents before being used in the main data collection. Data analysis included validity and reliability tests (Cronbach's Alpha), classical assumption tests (normality, linearity, and heteroscedasticity), Pearson correlation, and simple linear regression. title: Patterns of Fifth-Grade Students’ Difficulties in Solving Fraction Problems Across Mathematical Ability Levels
text_snippet: Patterns of Fifth-Grade Students’ Difficulties in Solving Fraction Problems Across Mathematical Ability Levels Fractions remain a challenging topic in elementary mathematics because successful problem solving requires students to coordinate problem comprehension, conceptual understanding, procedural knowledge, and mathematical representation. This study aimed to analyze the patterns of fifth-grade students’ difficulties in solving fraction problems across different mathematical ability levels. A descriptive qualitative design was employed involving 30 fifth-grade students at SD Negeri 8 Baubau, Indonesia. Data were collected through a 10-item open-ended fraction test administered to all participants and semi-structured interviews with three students representing high-, medium-, and low-ability levels. The data were analyzed through data reduction, data display, comparison of written responses and interview evidence, and conclusion drawing. The results showed that 20.00% of students were classified as high ability, 36.67% as medium ability, and 43.33% as low ability. Three major patterns of difficulty were identified: understanding fraction problems, performing fraction operations, and mathematical problem solving. title: Implementation of the Discovery Learning Model Assisted by Wordwall Games Media in History Learning
text_snippet: Implementation of the Discovery Learning Model Assisted by Wordwall Games Media in History Learning This study examines the planning and implementation of the Discovery Learning model assisted by Wordwall Games media in history learning and identifies the obstacles encountered during its implementation in class XI F1 of SMA Negeri 1 Sungai Rumbai. The study used a descriptive qualitative approach. The research informants consisted of the history teacher and students of class XI F1. Data were collected through classroom observation, interviews with the teacher and students, and documentation in the form of photographs and videos. Data were analyzed through data collection, data reduction, data presentation, and conclusion drawing. The findings show that the learning design was prepared by aligning the six Discovery Learning stages stimulation, problem statement, data collection, data processing, verification, and generalization with the historical material on the Proclamation of Indonesian Independence and the Rengasdengklok Event. Video was used at the stimulation stage, while Wordwall Games, particularly Match Up and Speaking Cards, was integrated mainly into verification and reinforcement activities. title: Modified Small-Sided Games to Strengthen Student Engagement in Football Dribbling Lessons: A Two-Cycle Classroom Action Study
text_snippet: Modified Small-Sided Games to Strengthen Student Engagement in Football Dribbling Lessons: A Two-Cycle Classroom Action Study Low participation during technique-centred physical education can restrict students’ opportunities to practise football dribbling in meaningful situations. This classroom action study examined whether progressively modified small-sided games could improve Grade VII students’ learning engagement during dribbling lessons. Twenty-eight students at SMP Negeri 58 Halmahera Selatan, Indonesia, participated in a pre-action phase and two action cycles following planning, action, observation, and reflection. Cycle I used Dribbling Zig-Zag Race and Dribbling Challenge Zone; Cycle II increased contextual complexity through one-versus-one defender tasks and modified mini-soccer. Four observable indicators—active participation, cooperation, enthusiasm, and discipline—were rated on a four-point scale. title: Peningkatan Pemahaman Konsep Nilai-Nilai Pancasila dalam Kehidupan Sehari-Hari melalui Model Pembelajaran Value Clarification Technique pada Peserta Didik Kelas V Sekolah Dasar
text_snippet: Peningkatan Pemahaman Konsep Nilai-Nilai Pancasila dalam Kehidupan Sehari-Hari melalui Model Pembelajaran Value Clarification Technique pada Peserta Didik Kelas V Sekolah Dasar Kajian ini berpijak dari rendahnya pemahaman konsep nilai-nilai Pancasila pada peserta didik kelas VB SD Negeri Genuksari 02 Semarang, yang dipicu oleh pola pembelajaran konvensional yang masih berpusat pada guru. Tujuannya adalah memaparkan penerapan model pembelajaran Value Clarification Technique (VCT) sekaligus menakar sejauh mana model ini mendongkrak pemahaman konsep nilai-nilai Pancasila dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Riset ini berbentuk Penelitian Tindakan Kelas (PTK) mengikuti model Kemmis dan McTaggart, dijalankan dalam dua siklus yang masing-masing mencakup perencanaan, tindakan, pengamatan, dan refleksi. Sebanyak 28 peserta didik (16 laki-laki, 12 perempuan) dilibatkan sebagai subjek melalui teknik total sampling. Data dihimpun lewat tes, observasi, dan dokumentasi, kemudian ditelaah secara terpadu dengan pendekatan kuantitatif dan kualitatif. Hasilnya memperlihatkan kenaikan berarti pada pemahaman konsep (translasi, interpretasi, ekstrapolasi), dengan rerata kelas naik dari 67,50 (pra-siklus) menjadi 86,10 (Siklus I) dan 88,20 (Siklus II). title: Analisis Media Pohon Baca sebagai Media Pendukung Keterampilan Membaca Anak Usia 5-6 Tahun di TK Nusa Indah I Dempet Demak
text_snippet: Analisis Media Pohon Baca sebagai Media Pendukung Keterampilan Membaca Anak Usia 5-6 Tahun di TK Nusa Indah I Dempet Demak Penggunaan media pohon baca sebagai media pendukung keterampilan membaca anak usia 5-6 tahun di TK Nusa Indah 1 Dempet Demak. Media pohon baca merupakan media visual berbentuk pohon yang dilengkapi kartu huruf, kata, suku kata, atau kalimat yang dapat dipasang dan dicopot sesuai kebutuhan pembelajaran. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis media pohon baca sebagai media pendukung keterampilan membaca anak 5-6 tahun di TK Nusa Indah I Dempet Demak. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan subyek 15 anak yang dipilih melalui purposive sampling. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi partisipatif, wawancara mendalam, dan dokumentasi. Analisis data menggunakan teknik reduksi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa anak mengalami perkembangan bertahap dalam keterampilan membaca, mulai dari pengenalan huruf awal, penyusunan kata sederhana, hingga penguatan pemahaman makna kata. Selain meningkatkan kemampuan membaca, media ini juga menumbuhkan motivasi belajar, keaktifan, keberanian mencoba membaca mandiri, dan interaksi sosial positif antaranak. title: Mapping School-Based Management Implementation in Senior High Schools in Ambon City: A Six-Factor Analysis in the Context of Maluku
text_snippet: Mapping School-Based Management Implementation in Senior High Schools in Ambon City: A Six-Factor Analysis in the Context of Maluku School-Based Management (SBM) enables schools to exercise greater autonomy in managing educational programs, resources, services, and stakeholder relationships in accordance with institutional and contextual needs. This study examined the profile of perceived SBM implementation among participating senior high schools in Ambon City using a six-factor framework incorporating the local context of Maluku. A quantitative cross-sectional descriptive survey was conducted involving 97 respondents from 10 public and private senior high schools. Schools were selected purposively, while quota-based recruitment was used to target approximately 10 respondents from each school. Data were collected using a 48-item, four-point Likert questionnaire organized into six empirically derived factors. Internal consistency across the six factors was adequate to very high (Cronbach’s α = 0.797–0.966). Quality-Oriented Leadership and Capacity Development recorded the highest mean score (M = 3.895, SD = 0.238), closely followed by Context-Responsive Adaptive Governance (M = 3.893, SD = 0.219). title: Rekonstruksi Paradigma Pembelajaran Matematika: Dari Absolutisme menuju Growth Mindset
text_snippet: Rekonstruksi Paradigma Pembelajaran Matematika: Dari Absolutisme menuju Growth Mindset Pembelajaran matematika di sekolah masih didominasi paradigma absolutisme yang menempatkan matematika sebagai ilmu yang pasti, objektif, dan berorientasi pada jawaban tunggal. Kondisi tersebut menyebabkan pembelajaran lebih menekankan hasil akhir dibanding proses berpikir siswa sehingga berpotensi membentuk fixed mindset dalam belajar matematika. Artikel ini bertujuan menganalisis rekonstruksi paradigma pembelajaran matematika dari absolutisme menuju growth mindset. Penelitian menggunakan metode kajian literatur dengan pendekatan deskriptif-kritis melalui analisis berbagai penelitian dan teori mengenai growth mindset dalam pendidikan matematika. Kebaruan artikel ini terletak pada upaya menghubungkan growth mindset dengan kritik terhadap paradigma absolutisme dalam pembelajaran matematika. Hasil kajian menunjukkan bahwa dominasi pembelajaran prosedural dan teacher centered learning masih menjadi hambatan dalam pengembangan kemampuan berpikir kritis, kreativitas, dan keberanian siswa menghadapi tantangan matematis. Growth mindset menawarkan paradigma alternatif yang memandang kemampuan matematika sebagai kemampuan yang dapat berkembang melalui proses belajar, refleksi, dan pengalaman

title: Students’ Self-Perceived English Communication Skills Before and After an International Internship Program in Taiwan
text_snippet: Students’ Self-Perceived English Communication Skills Before and After an International Internship Program in Taiwan International internship programs are widely promoted as a bridge between classroom English instruction and authentic workplace communication, yet few studies examine Indonesian interns using a design that captures the true direction of change in their communication skills. This study aimed to describe and examine whether Indonesian students' self-perceived English communication skills, namely speaking confidence and listening comprehension, differed significantly before and after undertaking an international internship program in Taiwan. A quantitative retrospective post-then-pre survey design was used, in which 40 Indonesian interns working in Taiwan's hospitality, restaurant, food processing, factory, and catering sectors, selected through purposive sampling, rated their perceived skills for both time points within a single 20-item Likert-scale questionnaire. Data were analyzed using the Shapiro-Wilk normality test on the difference scores and paired samples t-tests, with Cohen's dz reported as the effect size. title: Perbedaan Hasil Belajar Teori dan Hasil Belajar Praktik pada Mata Pelajaran Perpajakan SMK
text_snippet: Perbedaan Hasil Belajar Teori dan Hasil Belajar Praktik pada Mata Pelajaran Perpajakan SMK Pendidikan vokasi di SMK menekankan keseimbangan antara kompetensi teoritis dan keterampilan, namun dalam praktiknya sering ditemukan perbedaan antara hasil belajar teori dan hasil belajar praktik, terutama pada mata pelajaran perpajakan. title: Pengaruh Media Pembelajaran Video terhadap Hasil Belajar Siswa Kelas X SMK Akuntansi
text_snippet: Pengaruh Media Pembelajaran Video terhadap Hasil Belajar Siswa Kelas X SMK Akuntansi Video is one of the most commonly used teaching methods by educators. Spreadsheet instruction often faces challenges because teachers frequently explain formulas too quickly, making it difficult for some students to follow instructions and understand the formulas correctly. Student learning outcomes suffer as a result. Therefore, the objective of this study is to measure the effectiveness of using video as a teaching tool in influencing student learning outcomes at a vocational high school specializing in accounting. The uniqueness of this research approach lies in the use of video in spreadsheet calculation lessons, which provides students with the opportunity to review learning materials independently according to their needs. This study adopts a quantitative method and is based on a pretest-posttest design within a single group. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, normality tests, and paired t-tests. Data were collected through pretest and posttest scores from 34 students in Class X AK 3 at SMK Negeri 1 Turen. title: Pengaruh Model Jigsaw terhadap Motivasi Belajar Siswa pada Mata Pelajaran Pendidikan Agama Islam di Kelas VIII Sekolah Menengah pertama
text_snippet: Pengaruh Model Jigsaw terhadap Motivasi Belajar Siswa pada Mata Pelajaran Pendidikan Agama Islam di Kelas VIII Sekolah Menengah pertama Rendahnya motivasi belajar siswa pada mata pelajaran Pendidikan Agama Islam (PAI) sering kali disebabkan oleh penggunaan model pembelajaran yang kurang variatif. title: Integration of Local Wisdom of West Kalimantan in the Teaching Materials of My Region of Pride for Elementary School Students
text_snippet: Integration of Local Wisdom of West Kalimantan in the Teaching Materials of My Region of Pride for Elementary School Students The availability of teaching materials that contain the richness of local wisdom in West Kalimantan is still limited, while students need teaching materials that are more interesting and in accordance with their learning experience. This research aims to analyze the needs of teachers and students, develop teaching materials on the materials of My Pride Region, and determine the validity of the product. The research uses the Research and Development (R&D) method with a 4D model which includes define, design, development, and disseminate. Data was collected through interviews, observations, needs questionnaires, and expert validation, then analyzed descriptively. The results of the study show that there is a need for teaching materials that contain the local wisdom of West Kalimantan and have an interesting and easy-to-understand presentation. Two-stage validation showed an increase in scores on the design aspect from 3.41 to 4.33, language from 4.00 to 4.71, and learning from 3.84 to 4.40. title: Strategi Inovasi Guru TK Manba’ul Huda dalam Membangun Kepercayaan Diri Anak Pemalu
text_snippet: Strategi Inovasi Guru TK Manba’ul Huda dalam Membangun Kepercayaan Diri Anak Pemalu Penelitian ini dilakukan dengan tujuan untuk mendeskripsikan upaya guru dalam membentuk karakter percaya diri pada anak usia 5–6 tahun. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif dengan subjek penelitian sebanyak 50 anak usia 5–6 tahun. Data penelitian dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi. Data yang diperoleh dianalisis menggunakan tahap reduksi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa guru TK Manba’ul Huda menerapkan berbagai strategi inovatif dalam membangun kepercayaan diri anak, yaitu pembelajaran aktif dan kreatif, kegiatan tampil di depan kelas, bernyanyi sambil bergerak, menari, pemberian tugas dan tanggung jawab, pembiasaan kegiatan positif dan keagamaan, kesempatan menjadi pemimpin, kegiatan tanya jawab, pengembangan interaksi sosial, serta pemberian penghargaan verbal dan nonverbal. Dari 50 anak yang diamati, perubahan positif paling terlihat pada keberanian berinteraksi dengan teman, kemandirian menyelesaikan tugas, keberanian mencoba kegiatan baru, dan keberanian tampil di depan kelas. title: Analisis Kemampuan Guru MengimplementasikanPembelajaran Mendalam pada Desain Pedagogis
text_snippet: Analisis Kemampuan Guru MengimplementasikanPembelajaran Mendalam pada Desain Pedagogis Implementasi Pembelajaran Mendalam di sekolah dasar menuntut guru tidak hanya memahami prinsip berkesadaran, bermakna, dan menggembirakan, tetapi juga mampu menerjemahkannya secara konsisten ke dalam Perencanaan Pembelajaran Mendalam (PPM). Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis tingkat kesesuaian PPM yang disusun guru sekolah dasar dengan karakteristik Pembelajaran Mendalam serta mengidentifikasi kekuatan dan kelemahan integrasi ketiga prinsip tersebut dalam desain pembelajaran. title: Negotiating Professionalism in Montessori Schools: Organizational Culture and Professional Development Among Generation Z Employees
text_snippet: Negotiating Professionalism in Montessori Schools: Organizational Culture and Professional Development Among Generation Z Employees Educational organizations increasingly employ younger workers who are often classified as Generation Z, yet little is known about how such employees negotiate work values within value-based school cultures. In this study, Generation Z functions as a sampling context rather than an explanatory variable, and no intergenerational comparison is intended. This study examined how younger employees within this sampling context construct professionalism in two Montessori schools in Pekanbaru, Indonesia, and how educational-management practices shape their professional development. A qualitative multiple-case design involved 10 employees aged 22–29 years, comprising eight teachers and two administrative staff; the empirical analysis used participant interview excerpts, critical incidents, a 12-code analytical framework, within-case analysis, cross-case comparison, and negative/deviant case examination. Four themes were identified. Structured professional autonomy described agency as meaningful when paired with competence, clear boundaries, trust, and accountability. title: Meningkatkan Kemampuan Menulis Permulaan Huruf Vokal Melalui Metode Finger Painting pada Murid Disabilitas Intelektual Ringan
text_snippet: Meningkatkan Kemampuan Menulis Permulaan Huruf Vokal Melalui Metode Finger Painting pada Murid Disabilitas Intelektual Ringan Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kemampuan menulis permulaan huruf vokal melalui metode finger painting pada murid disabilitas intelektual ringan. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode Penelitian Tindakan Kelas (PTK) yang dilaksanakan dalam dua siklus. Subjek penelitian terdiri atas tiga murid disabilitas intelektual ringan dengan inisial ZR, NO, dan NM. Teknik pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi dan tes kemampuan menulis permulaan huruf vokal. Hasil asesmen awal menunjukkan bahwa ketiga murid memperoleh persentase kemampuan yang sama, yaitu sebesar 60%. Setelah diberikan tindakan menggunakan metode finger painting, terjadi peningkatan kemampuan pada setiap siklus. Pada siklus I pertemuan ketiga, ZR memperoleh persentase sebesar 75%, NO sebesar 69%, dan NM sebesar 75%. Selanjutnya, pada siklus II, kemampuan ZR meningkat menjadi 94%, NO menjadi 88%, dan NM menjadi 94%. Peningkatan tersebut menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan metode finger painting dapat membantu murid dalam meningkatkan kemampuan menulis permulaan huruf vokal. Metode ini memberikan pengalaman belajar yang melibatkan aktivitas motorik, visual, dan sentuhan sehingga pembelajaran menjadi lebih menarik dan memu

title: Penerapan Metode Montessori untuk Meningkatkan Kemampuan Membaca Permulaan Murid dengan Hambatan Pendengaran Kelas I di SLB Negeri Aek Kanopan
text_snippet: Penerapan Metode Montessori untuk Meningkatkan Kemampuan Membaca Permulaan Murid dengan Hambatan Pendengaran Kelas I di SLB Negeri Aek Kanopan Kemampuan membaca permulaan merupakan keterampilan dasar yang berperan penting dalam mendukung perkembangan bahasa dan keberhasilan akademik murid. Namun, murid dengan hambatan pendengaran sering mengalami kesulitan dalam mengenali huruf, membaca suku kata, kata, dan kalimat sederhana karena keterbatasan akses terhadap informasi auditif. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kemampuan membaca permulaan murid dengan hambatan pendengaran melalui penerapan metode Montessori di kelas I SLB Negeri Aek Kanopan. Penelitian menggunakan metode Penelitian Tindakan Kelas (PTK) yang dilaksanakan dalam tiga siklus. Subjek penelitian terdiri atas empat murid berinisial D, K, R, dan A. Data dikumpulkan melalui tes kemampuan membaca permulaan dan lembar observasi, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan teknik analisis deskriptif kuantitatif dan kualitatif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan adanya peningkatan kemampuan membaca permulaan pada seluruh subjek. Pada Siklus I, persentase capaian kemampuan membaca permulaan D sebesar 50%, K 58%, R 72%, dan A 79%. Metode penelitian dalam abstrak telah dinyatakan menggunakan tiga siklus, tetapi hasil yang dilaporkan hanya mencakup Siklus I dan Siklus II. Kondisi

title: Confidence in the Classroom: How Self-Efficacy Shapes the Independent Character of Senior High School Students in Science Learning Activities
text_snippet: Confidence in the Classroom: How Self-Efficacy Shapes the Independent Character of Senior High School Students in Science Learning Activities Indonesian education policy now names independence as part of the graduate profile, yet how students actually become independent during ordinary science lessons has rarely been examined up close. This study describes how self-efficacy shapes the independent character of eleventh-grade students during science learning activities at a state senior high school in Pacitan Regency. Using a qualitative case study, data were gathered from ten purposively selected students with contrasting self-efficacy tendencies and one science teacher through in-depth interviews, classroom observation, and document review, then analyzed thematically following Miles and Huberman with technique and source triangulation, member checking, thick description, and an audit trail. Independent character appeared in four connected aspects, namely responsibility, initiative, adaptability, and self-reflection, all observable in group discussion, presentation, and written tasks rather than laboratory work. Students with stronger self-efficacy showed a fuller and steadier pattern, while several students with weaker self-efficacy began to grow after small successes and encouragement. title: Efektivitas Media Video Tutorial dalam Meningkatkan Keterampilan Vokasional Merias Wajah Karakter untuk Murid Disabilitas Rungu
text_snippet: Efektivitas Media Video Tutorial dalam Meningkatkan Keterampilan Vokasional Merias Wajah Karakter untuk Murid Disabilitas Rungu Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis efektivitas media video tutorial dalam meningkatkan keterampilan vokasional merias wajah karakter pada murid disabilitas rungu. Penelitian menggunakan metode eksperimen dengan desain Single Subject Research (SSR) tipe A-B-A. Subjek penelitian adalah satu murid disabilitas rungu kelas X di SLB Aisyiyah Sijunjung. Data dikumpulkan melalui tes unjuk kerja menggunakan lembar checklist dan dianalisis secara visual berdasarkan kecenderungan, stabilitas, serta perubahan level data. Fase baseline A1 dilaksanakan sebanyak 3 sesi, intervensi B sebanyak 5 sesi, dan baseline A2 sebanyak 3 sesi. Hasil analisis menunjukkan bahwa kemampuan merias wajah karakter pada fase A1 berada pada level 58,3% dengan kecenderungan stabil. Setelah diberikan intervensi berupa video tutorial pada fase B, kemampuan meningkat secara bertahap dari 66,6% menjadi 79,1%, yang menunjukkan perubahan level positif dibandingkan kondisi awal. Pada fase A2, kemampuan kembali meningkat hingga 87,5% dan selanjutnya menunjukkan kondisi stabil. title: Penerapan Permainan Ular Tangga untuk Meningkatkan Kemampuan Berhitung Siswa Kelas 1 Sekolah Dasar
text_snippet: Penerapan Permainan Ular Tangga untuk Meningkatkan Kemampuan Berhitung Siswa Kelas 1 Sekolah Dasar Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kemampuan berhitung siswa kelas I SDN 030 Sabbangloang melalui penerapan permainan ular tangga. Penelitian menggunakan metode Penelitian Tindakan Kelas (PTK) yang dilaksanakan dalam dua siklus, dengan tahapan perencanaan, pelaksanaan tindakan, observasi, dan refleksi. Subjek penelitian berjumlah 20 siswa kelas I. Data dikumpulkan melalui tes kemampuan berhitung dan observasi aktivitas siswa, kemudian dianalisis secara deskriptif kuantitatif dan kualitatif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa nilai rata-rata siswa meningkat dari 43 pada pra-siklus menjadi 70 pada siklus I dan 87 pada siklus II. Persentase ketuntasan belajar meningkat dari 20% pada pra-siklus menjadi 50% pada siklus I dan 85% pada siklus II. Pada siklus II, sebanyak 17 dari 20 siswa memperoleh nilai minimal 70 sehingga indikator keberhasilan sebesar 75% telah tercapai. Dengan demikian, penerapan permainan ular tangga dapat meningkatkan kemampuan berhitung siswa kelas I SDN 030 Sabbangloang.

title: Preserving Calung Through Arts Education: Situated Learning and Digital Engagement Among Sundanese Youth
text_snippet: Preserving Calung Through Arts Education: Situated Learning and Digital Engagement Among Sundanese Youth This study examines the role of arts education in preserving the traditional art of Calung among Sundanese youth in Garut, Indonesia, focusing on the integration of situated learning and digital engagement. Utilizing a post-activity quantitative descriptive approach with a one-shot case study design, research was conducted with 25 youth participants from the Cahaya Gumelar Art Group in Jongor Village. Data were collected through a Likert-scale questionnaire to measure cognitive, affective, and conative responses, supplemented by structured interviews with community leaders and cultural elders. The findings demonstrate that the program was associated with high levels of participants' cultural engagement. Post-intervention, youth displayed high levels of cultural pride (96%) and a strong commitment (92%) to continuous participation in weekly practice. The combination of hands-on situated learning with digital media production was reported to be highly effective in rekindling cultural ownership and addressing local regeneration barriers. title: Cultural Values, Health Literacy, and the Transformation of Traditional Medicine Practices in Modernized Societies: A Systematic Literature Review
text_snippet: Cultural Values, Health Literacy, and the Transformation of Traditional Medicine Practices in Modernized Societies: A Systematic Literature Review Traditional medicine (TM) remains an important component of healthcare systems worldwide because it is deeply embedded in cultural values, indigenous knowledge, and community-based health practices. However, modernization, scientific advancement, and changing health information environments have transformed the ways in which traditional medicine is understood, practiced, and integrated into contemporary healthcare systems. This study aims to examine the role of cultural values and health literacy in shaping the transformation of traditional medicine practices in modernized societies. A systematic literature review was conducted following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines. Literature searches were performed across four international databases, namely Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, and ScienceDirect. A total of 15 international scientific articles were selected through a systematic identification, screening, eligibility assessment, and inclusion process. title: Meningkatkan Kemampuan Mengenal Lambang Bilangan pada Murid Disabilitas Intelektual Ringan dengan Menggunakan Media Marbel Fun Number
text_snippet: Meningkatkan Kemampuan Mengenal Lambang Bilangan pada Murid Disabilitas Intelektual Ringan dengan Menggunakan Media Marbel Fun Number Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh rendahnya kemampuan mengenal lambang bilangan cacah 1–10 pada murid disabilitas intelektual ringan kelas IV SDLB Negeri Aek Kanopan. Murid mengalami kesulitan mengenali lambang bilangan, menghitung benda konkret secara tepat, serta mempertahankan fokus ketika menghitung objek yang disusun secara acak. Penelitian ini bertujuan meningkatkan kemampuan mengenal lambang bilangan cacah 1–10 melalui penggunaan media Marbel Fun Number. Metode yang digunakan adalah Penelitian Tindakan Kelas (PTK) yang dilaksanakan dalam dua siklus. Subjek penelitian terdiri atas dua murid disabilitas intelektual ringan berinisial P dan R. Teknik pengumpulan data menggunakan tes dan observasi, sedangkan analisis data dilakukan secara deskriptif kuantitatif dan kualitatif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan adanya peningkatan kemampuan mengenal lambang bilangan pada kedua subjek. Pada asesmen awal, murid P memperoleh nilai 25% dan murid R memperoleh nilai 40%. Setelah tindakan pada Siklus I, nilai P meningkat menjadi 50% dan R menjadi 55%. Peningkatan yang lebih optimal terlihat pada Siklus II, yaitu P memperoleh nilai 85% dan R mencapai 95%. title: Exploring Generative AI Assisted Thesis Writing Behaviors Among EFL Students in Pesantren-Based Higher Education
text_snippet: Exploring Generative AI Assisted Thesis Writing Behaviors Among EFL Students in Pesantren-Based Higher Education This study aims to investigate undergraduate EFL students’ writing behaviors and ethical considerations in using Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) during undergraduate thesis writing. The study focuses on how students use GenAI as an assistive tool in planning, drafting, and revising their theses, as well as how they maintain academic integrity in processing AI-generated outputs. This research employed a qualitative multiple case study design involving three undergraduate students at STIT Misbahudin Ahmad Blitar, a pesantren-based Islamic higher education institution in East Java, Indonesia. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews, observation, and document analysis, and were analyzed using the interactive model of Miles, Huberman, and Saldaña, consisting of data condensation, data display, conclusion drawing, and verification. The findings show that students used GenAI to explore topics, refine research titles, identify research gaps, formulate research questions, transform ideas into academic text, improve sentence clarity, correct grammar, and revise paragraph organization. title: Penerapan Reinforcement Positif untuk Meningkatkan Konsentrasi Anak dengan Gangguan Spektrum Autisme
text_snippet: Penerapan Reinforcement Positif untuk Meningkatkan Konsentrasi Anak dengan Gangguan Spektrum Autisme Reinforcement positif merupakan salah satu strategi modifikasi perilaku yang dapat digunakan untuk mendukung peningkatan konsentrasi peserta didik dengan Gangguan Spektrum Autisme (GSA) dalam pembelajaran di kelas. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan durasi konsentrasi dua peserta didik GSA, yaitu FZA dan QA, di kelas VI SLB Negeri Doloksanggul melalui penerapan reinforcement positif. Penelitian menggunakan metode Penelitian Tindakan Kelas (PTK) dengan model Kemmis dan McTaggart yang terdiri atas tahap perencanaan, tindakan, observasi, dan refleksi dalam dua siklus. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi langsung terhadap durasi konsentrasi peserta didik selama mengikuti kegiatan pembelajaran. Reinforcement positif diberikan secara langsung setelah peserta didik menunjukkan perilaku yang diharapkan, seperti memperhatikan guru, duduk mengikuti kegiatan pembelajaran, dan mengerjakan tugas. Data dianalisis menggunakan teknik deskriptif kuantitatif dan kualitatif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan adanya peningkatan durasi konsentrasi pada kedua peserta didik. title: The Impact of the Drill and Practice Learning Model on the Cognitive Development of Students in the Concrete Operational Stage
text_snippet: The Impact of the Drill and Practice Learning Model on the Cognitive Development of Students in the Concrete Operational Stage Addition is a fundamental arithmetic concept that is abstract for students still in the concrete operational stage of cognitive development. To address this, an appropriate instructional model was selected to facilitate student understanding; specifically, the teacher chose a "drill and practice" model to allow students to explore their grasp of addition. However, challenges arose during the process, given that the students were in a transitional phase between the preoperational and concrete operational stages. This study examines the phenomena observed in the cognitive development of students in the concrete operational stage resulting from the implementation of the drill and practice model. Data collection involved interview and classroom observation. The study yielded both positive and negative findings regarding the students' cognitive development. title: Exploring the Implementation of the Teams Games Tournament Model to Increase Students’ Enthusiasm for Learning Arabic at MTSN 1 Sarolangun
text_snippet: Exploring the Implementation of the Teams Games Tournament Model to Increase Students’ Enthusiasm for Learning Arabic at MTSN 1 Sarolangun Arabic language learning at the junior secondary level often faces challenges related to students’ limited participation and enthusiasm. This study aims to explore the implementation of the Teams-Games-Tournament (TGT) model in Arabic language learning and to examine students’ responses and enthusiasm during the learning process at MTsN 1 Sarolangun. This study employed a qualitative case study approach. Data were collected through classroom observations, interviews, and documentation involving participants directly engaged in the learning activities. The data were analyzed using the Miles and Huberman qualitative data analysis framework, including data collection, data condensation, data display, and conclusion drawing and verification. The findings indicate that the implementation of the TGT model provided students with opportunities to participate more actively through teamwork, educational games, discussion, vocabulary practice, and healthy competition. Students’ enthusiasm was reflected in their willingness to participate, interaction with peers, cooperation, positive responses to learning activities, and interest in practicing Arabic vocabulary. journal_name: Journal of Social and Scientific Education
title: Kurikulum Pendidikan Agama Islam di Era Globalisasi: Problematika, Adaptasi, dan Transformasi
text_snippet: Kurikulum Pendidikan Agama Islam di Era Globalisasi: Problematika, Adaptasi, dan Transformasi Perkembangan globalisasi dan teknologi digital menuntut kurikulum Pendidikan Agama Islam (PAI) mampu mengintegrasikan nilai-nilai Islam dengan kompetensi abad ke-21. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis problematika pengembangan kurikulum PAI serta merumuskan arah pengembangannya melalui pendekatan kualitatif dengan metode Systematic Literature Review (SLR). Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kurikulum PAI masih didominasi pembelajaran kognitif dan hafalan, belum optimal mengintegrasikan literasi digital, penguatan karakter, moderasi beragama, serta pemanfaatan teknologi dalam pembelajaran. Selain itu, kompetensi digital pendidik dan kontekstualisasi materi masih menjadi tantangan utama. Oleh karena itu, pengembangan kurikulum PAI perlu diarahkan pada integrasi literasi digital, penguatan karakter dan moderasi beragama, peningkatan kompetensi guru, serta penerapan pembelajaran inovatif berbasis teknologi agar kurikulum tetap adaptif, kontekstual, dan relevan tanpa mengabaikan nilai-nilai fundamental Islam.

title: Innovation of the Adaptive Social Inquiry Learning Model in Strengthening Students' Creative Thinking Skills
text_snippet: Innovation of the Adaptive Social Inquiry Learning Model in Strengthening Students' Creative Thinking Skills This study aims to develop the Adaptive Social Inquiry (ASI) learning model as an innovation in strengthening students' creative thinking skills in social studies. The type of research used is Research and Development with the Plomp development model which includes preliminary research, development, and assessment stages. The exploration stage is carried out through teacher and student needs analysis, literature review, and initial measurement of creative thinking skills. The results of the analysis indicate that students' creative thinking skills are still relatively low in the aspects of fluency, flexibility, originality, and elaboration. Next, the development stage is carried out by designing a prototype of the ASI model that integrates inquiry learning syntax with social adaptation, and compiling an assessment instrument validated by experts. The results of expert validation of the instrument, module, graphic design, and language show a very good category, with an instrument reliability of 0.836 (≥ 0.70). title: Artificial Intelligence in Indonesian Guidance and Counseling Services: A Systematic Review of Teachers' Readiness
text_snippet: Artificial Intelligence in Indonesian Guidance and Counseling Services: A Systematic Review of Teachers' Readiness The development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has brought about significant changes in the world of education, including in school guidance and counseling practices. AI offers various opportunities, such as analyzing student needs, personalizing services, detecting psychological issues early, and providing digital-based counseling services. However, the successful integration of AI into counseling services depends heavily on the readiness of guidance and counseling teachers as the primary providers of these services. This study aims to comprehensively examine the readiness of guidance and counseling teachers to integrate AI into guidance and counseling services, based on the findings of previous research. The method employed is a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) using the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. This study covers publications from 2020 to 2026 obtained from Scopus and Google Scholar and supplemented by additional searching. title: Improving Elementary School Students’ Science Process Skills Through the PDEODE Instructional Model
text_snippet: Improving Elementary School Students’ Science Process Skills Through the PDEODE Instructional Model Basic science process skills (SPS) of fifth-grade students on the water cycle topic remain low due to the dominance of conventional, transmission-based instruction. This study aimed to examine the effect of the PDEODE learning model on improving these skills. A quantitative quasi-experimental approach with a nonequivalent control group design was employed, involving 51 fifth-grade students (26 experimental, 25 control) selected through purposive sampling at Public Elementary School 54 Salupikung, Palopo. Data were collected using a validated and reliable basic SPS test (15 short-answer items, CVI = 0.92, α = 0.84) administered as a pretest and posttest, and analyzed using descriptive statistics, N-gain calculation, prerequisite tests, and an independent-samples t-test. title: Social Media Usage and the Academic Engagement of Junior High School Students in Northwestern Ghana
text_snippet: Social Media Usage and the Academic Engagement of Junior High School Students in Northwestern Ghana Despite the growing prevalence of social media among adolescents, limited research has examined its direct impact on academic engagement among Junior High School (JHS) students in underserved contexts. While prior studies have explored social media’s effects on academic performance, procrastination, and peer interaction, few have investigated how students’ digital behaviours influence engagement in learning activities, highlighting an important empirical gap. This study argues that social media exerts a dual influence, simultaneously enabling learning through collaboration and access to educational resources, while also fostering distraction and superficial learning. Guided by the research question, "How do social media use patterns and contextual factors shape the academic engagement of JHS students in the Wa Municipality?" the study adopted a qualitative approach. Data were collected through focus group discussions and semi-structured interviews with purposively sampled students, teachers, and parents. title: How AI-Assisted Learning Satisfies Students' Psychological Needs: Evidence from Taiwan Universities
text_snippet: How AI-Assisted Learning Satisfies Students' Psychological Needs: Evidence from Taiwan Universities Despite widespread AI adoption in universities globally, current implementations may inadvertently undermine learning engagement, with students reporting AI use primarily due to external pressures rather than genuine interest. This disconnect between technological sophistication and psychological understanding poses immediate challenges for educational institutions seeking to maximize AI benefits while supporting student wellbeing. This study examines how AI-assisted learning influences students' basic psychological needs satisfaction through Self-Determination Theory in Taiwanese university contexts, providing the first systematic investigation of all three psychological needs (competence, autonomy, relatedness) simultaneously within AI learning environments. A cross-sectional survey of 200 Taiwanese university students was conducted using structural equation modeling, with validated scales measuring AI-assisted learning usage and basic psychological needs satisfaction (competence, autonomy, relatedness). journal_name: Journal of Social and Scientific Education
title: Teachers’ Familiarity, Readiness, and Anticipated Benefits and Barriers of Generative AI in Design and Technology Education
text_snippet: Teachers’ Familiarity, Readiness, and Anticipated Benefits and Barriers of Generative AI in Design and Technology Education The rapid advancement of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) raises pressing questions about teacher readiness to integrate emerging technologies into classroom practice, particularly in Design and Technology education, where creativity and project-based learning are central. This study investigates teachers’ familiarity, readiness, and perceptions of GenAI following a targeted professional development workshop. A mixed-methods survey of 147 in-service teachers combined Likert-scale items with open-ended responses. Quantitative results indicated strong readiness and high perceived benefits, especially for fostering creativity, enhancing student engagement, and supporting project-based work. Correlation analysis showed that readiness was closely associated with perceived benefits, while barriers were less influential. Thematic analysis of open-ended responses highlighted four themes: pedagogical benefits, opportunities for professional growth, barriers to long-term adoption, and recommendations for sustained implementation.
